description: Requirement specification chunks. The platform treats REQ-* and the canonical valid-from window as protected anchors.

chunks.text: REQ-471: the platform MUST expose a /v1/trace/requirement endpoint that, given a requirement id, returns the implementation sites and the test cases that reference it. Valid from 2026-01-01.
Test REQ-471: Given the requirement id REQ-471, the /v1/trace/requirement endpoint returns the implementation sites. The test asserts the response shape against the documented schema.
REQ-900 v1: a validFrom window of 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. The v1 spec described the in-process event bus; deprecated by v2.
REQ-900 v2: a validFrom window of 2026-01-01 onwards. The v2 spec describes the canonical message bus and supersedes the in-process event bus described in v1.
